title: dianthus pungens subsp. brachyanthus
intro: Dianthus pungens subsp. brachyanthus, commonly known as the fragrant pink or pink fringed pink, is a plant species in the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Dianthus pungens subsp. brachyanthus include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety and stress, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
